verdict.rationale: Vue's docs say it builds on standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Hands-on reports describe single-file components that separate HTML, JS and scoped CSS, with a learning curve of minutes to hours (vue-comm-6, 11, 12, 13, 15, 17). Some users note the template language adds its own directives and syntax, and TypeScript prop typing needs Vue-specific PropType casts, which limits the 'minimal new concepts' claim. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the standard-syntax approach (only a one-line claim), templates free of new directive syntax, and first-class TypeScript typing using plain interfaces.
